title.narrative: Enhancing Teacher Capacity in ESD and STEM Education: Learning for the Future

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen the competencies of 35 teachers to effectively integrate Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) and STEM approaches into classroom teaching and learning. The project will equip teachers with the knowledge, pedagogical skills, and practical tools needed to foster critical thinking, problem-solving, innovation, and environmental responsibility among learners. Through targeted training, hands-on activities, and mentoring support, participating teachers will develop and implement learner-centered lessons that connect STEM concepts with real-world sustainability challenges. The initiative seeks to promote quality, inclusive, and future-oriented education while contributing to the achievement of SDG 4 and broader sustainable development goals.
